product_thesis: Turn a civic question into a defensible evidence workflow: discover what data fits, identify evidence roles and gaps, validate whether sources can actually work together, execute bounded checks, and recommend the right representation while preserving provenance.

user_experience.canonical_design: DESIGN.md — premium Swiss/public-service workbench; keep this visual language
normal_user_journey: Describe what you want to understand or build
Identify missing or weak evidence roles
Fill appropriate gaps from curated official Swiss sources
Validate only the relationships required for that result
Show confirmed, rejected, partial and unresolved claims clearly
user_experience.internal_only_concept: Compose remains an implementation concept; do not make arbitrary dataset pairing the main user workflow

implemented: Live Basel-Stadt OpenDataSoft catalogue adapter with ordered/de-duplicated pagination and explicit fallback mode
Hierarchical D3 Atlas with Topic / Space / Time / Readiness lenses
One deterministic hierarchy containing every loaded dataset
Semantic zoom/focus controls and settled/non-drifting visualization
Evidence plan with roles, required/optional status, unresolved roles and external dependencies
Dataset structure/schema/sample inspection with provenance levels
Deterministic compatibility assessment including unknown/incompatible states
Referenceable assessments and execution_validated evidence level
GeoJSON/Turf execution for selected containment, nearest and aggregate operations
Execution result status separated from proposal status
Renderer-independent RepresentationSpec and deterministic recommendation logic
important_real_data_findings: Basel Baumkronenbedeckung is a 3-row raster-link table, not directly usable canopy geometry
Basel Baustellen has no geometry; Allmendbewilligungen provides permit polygons
Air-quality evidence is sparse and some stations sit outside relevant city extents
Alltagsvelorouten contains only 21 curated lines and is not a general street/routing network
Every tested high-confidence nearest proposal was rejected by execution, so proximity confidence cannot be inferred from schema/extent alone
Tempo-30 data contains at least one feature with missing geometry despite polygon declaration
A spatial operation can execute correctly while the analytical relationship remains weak

current_next_milestone.name: Trusted Evidence Registry v1
current_next_milestone.goal: When Basel evidence is missing or materially weak, resolve only from a small curated registry of official Swiss public-data sources.
priority_sources: swisstopo / geo.admin.ch — road/path backbone and elevation/terrain
opendata.swiss — metadata discovery and source validation, not runtime federation
required_sequence: Research and verify real official endpoints, formats, CORS, licensing and limits
Add a small explicit trusted-source registry
Add an EvidenceResolver that prefers adequate Basel evidence and fills only unresolved/weak roles
Keep national candidates clearly separate from validated compatibility claims
Implement the smallest useful MeteoSwiss/swisstopo adapters if direct browser use is practical
Integrate national support into Build UX rather than adding a second catalogue browser
Use the running case as the main acceptance demo

after_current_milestone: Representation preview/rendering using the existing RepresentationSpec contract: small MapLibre + Observable Plot + HTML evidence brief set
Then MCP orchestrator exposing the proven evidence workflow to external LLM hosts
Later: Worker/history/change feed, broader trusted-source registry, full catalogue federation, optional LLM enrichment
do_not_build_yet: MCP before the trusted-source and representation flows are coherent
Arbitrary web search as evidence resolution
Live LLM taxonomy as source truth
Worker/history service unless a verified source integration requires a minimal proxy
